null_subspace_disclosure.finding: every panel sample carries n_null GEVP modes at lambda <= TAU_POS.  Those eigenvalues are DEGENERATE, so the eigenvector basis inside the null subspace -- and hence the split of the spectral weight q_k between scree bar 0 and scree bar 1 -- is LAPACK-build dependent and is NOT a reproducible number.  The null subspace's TOTAL weight and every positive mode ARE reproducible.  This is a property of the published construction, exposed by re-running it; it is disclosed, not repaired.
